# X Pixel

Apply the [media contract](../../media/common.md) and its linked implementation owners.

## Select pixel and conversion identities

Establish account/use, Pixel ID, exact platform conversion-event identity, action,
optimization/audience purpose, source event and environment. Research
https://business.x.com/en/help/campaign-measurement-and-analytics/conversion-tracking-for-websites
and inspect current installed template/partner capability and deprecations.

Base pixel and lower-funnel event identity have distinct roles. Event implementation requires its
supplied/created platform identity. Reconcile partner objects, site code, automatic landing-page
behavior and any dataLayer Standard Events option before selecting manual occurrence ownership.

## Map and verify

Use the current value/currency/content and conversion fields with actual catalog conventions and
complete item projections. Matching follows [identity](../../data/identity.md); consent follows
[capability classification](../../consent/product-capabilities.md). Saved proof covers exact Pixel
and event identities, fields, automatic ownership and selected scope. Events Manager, audiences,
catalog and platform testing remain external work.

## Server route

For the exact X Conversion API product, load [Server](server.md). Establish account access, installed
implementation, request schema, `conversion_id` semantics and browser overlap.
